verdict.rationale: ReadMe's Docs Audit and Linter can detect broken links and style issues across the site, and the rdme CLI (confirmed installable/runnable) exists as a docs-as-code surface that could be scripted into CI, plus Reviews gate changes before merge — but there is no documented feature that explicitly runs as a CI check to block publishing on broken links or invalid OpenAPI/config before deploy. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Action) that fails a build on link/config errors pre-publish, and any hands-on confirmation this blocks a release.
